title: A View-only user can browse Active and Inactive but opens no edit window
custom_preconds: User with Part Library and Inventory View only. One inactive part.
custom_steps:
1. Parts, Inventory: switch Active and Inactive
  2. Click a part row
  3. Part Library
custom_expected:
1. Both lists load; no New Inventory Part, no actions menu, no row checkboxes
  2. Nothing opens
  3. No pencil or delete on entries
